source: James Legge, The Yî King (Sacred Books of the East XVI, 1882; 2nd ed. 1899), paraphrased; Chinese names from the received text

hexagrams.judgment_en: The Creative brings great and originating success; it is advantageous to be firm and correct.
hexagrams.image_en: Heaven moves with unceasing strength; the superior person likewise nerves himself to ceaseless activity.

lines.text_en: The dragon lies hidden in the deep; it is not the time to act.
The dragon appears in the field; it will be advantageous to meet the great person.
The superior person is active all day and still watchful at nightfall; the position is perilous but there will be no mistake.
The dragon seems to be leaping up yet still in the deep; there will be no mistake.
The dragon is on the wing in the sky; it will be advantageous to meet the great person.
The dragon has flown too high and exceeded its proper limits; there will be occasion for repentance.

hexagrams.judgment_en: The Receptive brings great and originating success through the firmness of a mare; if the superior person takes the lead he goes astray, but if he follows he finds his proper lord, and friends are found in the south-west and lost in the north-east.
hexagrams.image_en: The earth carries all things in its capacious receptivity; the superior person with large virtue supports people and things.

lines.text_en: Treading on hoarfrost, one knows that solid ice is soon to come.
Straight, square and great, one accomplishes everything without purposeful effort.
One keeps one’s excellence under restraint while serving the king, claiming no success but bringing the work to completion.
A sack tied up: no blame and no praise.
The yellow lower garment; there will be great good fortune.
Dragons fighting in the wild, their blood purple and yellow.

hexagrams.judgment_en: Difficulty at the Beginning brings great success through firm correctness; do not seek to move in any direction, but it is advantageous to appoint feudal princes (helpers).
hexagrams.image_en: Clouds and thunder form the image of initial difficulty; the superior person brings order out of confusion by adjusting his measures as in sorting threads.

lines.text_en: Hesitation and obstacle at the threshold; it is advantageous to remain firm and correct and to appoint helpers.
One is distressed and obliged to return; the horses of the chariot turn back, yet the suitor is not a robber but seeks a union, and the maiden refuses until ten years pass.
One follows deer without a forester and only loses himself in the forest; the superior person sees it is better to give up, for going forward brings regret.
The horses of the chariot turn back, yet if one seeks the union, advancing brings good fortune and nothing but advantage.
Difficulty in dispensing the rich favours one would bestow; firmness in small things brings good fortune, in great things misfortune.
The horses of the chariot turn back and tears of blood flow in streams.

hexagrams.judgment_en: Youthful Folly brings success: it is not I who seek the youthful and inexperienced, but they who seek me; at the first divination I instruct, but if they ask a second and third time it is troublesome and I do not answer; firm correctness is advantageous.
hexagrams.image_en: A spring issuing at the foot of a mountain; the superior person strives to be resolute in his conduct and to nourish his virtue.

lines.text_en: To dispel ignorance it is advantageous to apply discipline, yet to keep using fetters leads to regret.
One bears with the ignorant kindly; to take a wife brings good fortune, and the son can manage the household.
Do not marry the woman who sees a man of wealth and loses possession of herself; nothing is advantageous.
Entangled in ignorance, one will have occasion for regret.
The simplicity of a youth who seeks instruction brings good fortune.
In punishing ignorance one should ward off wrongdoing rather than commit it.

hexagrams.judgment_en: Waiting with sincerity brings brilliant success; firm correctness brings good fortune, and it is advantageous to cross the great stream.
hexagrams.image_en: Clouds ascend to the sky in the image of waiting; the superior person eats, drinks, feasts and enjoys himself as if nothing troubled him.

lines.text_en: Waiting in the distant border; it is well to persist, and there will be no error.
Waiting on the sand; there will be some small talk against you, but in the end good fortune.
Waiting in the mud brings on the approach of robbers.
Waiting in the place of blood; one gets out of the pit.
Waiting amid wine and food; firm correctness brings good fortune.
One enters the pit and three uninvited guests arrive; receive them with respect and in the end there will be good fortune.

hexagrams.judgment_en: In Conflict one is sincere yet meets obstruction; a cautious halt midway brings good fortune, pressing to the end misfortune; it is advantageous to see the great person but not to cross the great stream.
hexagrams.image_en: Heaven and water move away from each other in the image of conflict; the superior person considers the beginning carefully in all his undertakings.

lines.text_en: One does not perpetuate the matter in dispute; there is a little talk, but the end is fortunate.
Unequal to the contest, one retires and hides among three hundred households of his village, avoiding calamity.
One lives on the ancient virtue of his family; firmness amid peril brings good fortune in the end, and in the king’s service claims no merit.
Unequal to the contest, one returns to the study of the heavenly ordinance, changes his wish and rests in firmness; good fortune.
Contending before the one who decides with great justice; there will be great good fortune.
Even if one is awarded a leather belt of honour, it will be stripped away three times in a morning.

hexagrams.judgment_en: The Army needs firm correctness and a leader of age and experience; then there will be good fortune and no error.
hexagrams.image_en: Water in the midst of the earth is the image of the army; the superior person nourishes and educates the people and collects multitudes.

lines.text_en: The host sets out according to the rules; if these are not good, there will be misfortune.
The leader is in the midst of the host; good fortune, no error, and the king thrice confers favours.
The host may carry corpses in its wagons; misfortune.
The host retreats and encamps on the left; there is no error.
There are birds in the fields and it is advantageous to seize them, yet if the eldest son leads and younger ones carry corpses, firmness brings misfortune.
The great ruler delivers his charge, founding states and enfeoffing clans; small people should not be employed.

hexagrams.judgment_en: Holding Together brings good fortune; let one examine himself by divination whether he has the virtue to be the centre of union, and the late-comer meets misfortune.
hexagrams.image_en: Water on the earth in the image of union; the ancient kings established the states and cultivated affection with the princes.

lines.text_en: Seeking union with sincerity brings no error; sincerity full as an earthen vessel attracts good fortune from without.
Union proceeding from the inner self; firm correctness brings good fortune.
One seeks union with those who are not the right people.
Union with the one outside oneself above; firm correctness brings good fortune.
The most illustrious union: the king drives game on three sides and lets the animals in front escape, and the people need no warning; good fortune.
One seeks union but has no head to it; misfortune.

hexagrams.name_en_modern: The Taming Power of the Small
hexagrams.judgment_en: The Taming Power of the Small brings success; dense clouds come from our western borders but no rain falls.
hexagrams.image_en: Wind moves across heaven in the image of small restraint; the superior person adorns the outward manifestation of his virtue.

lines.text_en: One returns to his own path; what mistake could there be? good fortune.
One is drawn back along the path by others; good fortune.
The spokes of the carriage are broken, and husband and wife look at each other with averted eyes.
Sincerity makes blood and fear depart; there will be no error.
Sincere and bound in loyalty to its neighbour, one is enriched together with them.
The rain has fallen and progress is stayed; the virtue is honoured but the wife in persistence invites peril, for the moon is nearly full and the superior person who moves on will meet misfortune.

hexagrams.judgment_en: Treading on the tail of a tiger which does not bite the person; there will be progress and success.
hexagrams.image_en: Heaven above and the marsh below are the image of treading; the superior person discriminates between high and low and gives settlement to the aims of the people.

lines.text_en: One treads his accustomed path simply; going forward there will be no error.
One treads the level, easy path; the firm correctness of a quiet solitary person brings good fortune.
A one-eyed man thinks he can see and a lame man that he can walk; he treads on the tiger’s tail and is bitten, misfortune, like a soldier playing the great ruler.
One treads on the tiger’s tail with apprehension and caution; in the end there will be good fortune.
Resolute treading; firm correctness, but with peril.
One looks back at the whole course trodden and examines the omens; if all is complete there will be great good fortune.

hexagrams.judgment_en: In Peace the small departs and the great approaches; there will be good fortune with progress and success.
hexagrams.image_en: Heaven and earth communicate in the image of peace; the ruler fashions and completes the courses of heaven and earth to help the people.

lines.text_en: Grass is pulled up and brings the roots of its kind with it; advancing brings good fortune.
One bears with the uncultivated, crosses the river without a boat, does not forget the distant, and has no selfish friendships, walking in the middle path.
There is no plain without a slope and no going without a return; firmness amid difficulty is without error, and one enjoys the happiness one has.
One flutters down without boasting of wealth, together with neighbours, trusting without being warned.
The emperor Yi gives his younger sister in marriage; by this there is happiness and great good fortune.
The city wall returns to the moat; do not use the army now, but issue orders only to one’s own town, for firmness brings regret.

hexagrams.judgment_en: Standstill: there is a lack of good understanding among people, and firm correctness of the superior person does not avail; the great departs and the small approaches.
hexagrams.image_en: Heaven and earth do not communicate in the image of standstill; the superior person restrains his virtue to avoid calamity and does not accept honour or emolument.

lines.text_en: Grass is pulled up with the roots of its kind; firm correctness brings good fortune and success.
The small people patiently endure and flatter; for the superior person to endure the standstill brings success.
One bears shame for what he has in mind.
One acts in accordance with the ordinance of heaven and commits no error; companions share in the blessing.
Standstill ceases for the great person, good fortune, but he keeps saying “it may fail, it may fail” and ties it to a clump of mulberry.
The standstill is overthrown; before there was standstill, afterwards joy.

hexagrams.judgment_en: Fellowship with people in the open field brings progress and success; it is advantageous to cross the great stream and to maintain the firm correctness of the superior person.
hexagrams.image_en: Heaven with fire beneath it is the image of fellowship; the superior person distinguishes things according to their kinds and classes.

lines.text_en: Fellowship at the gate; there will be no error.
Fellowship only with one’s own clan; there will be occasion for regret.
One hides weapons in the thicket and climbs a high hill to watch, and for three years does not rise.
One mounts the city wall but cannot attack; good fortune.
In fellowship one first wails and cries out and afterwards laughs; the great host conquers and they meet together.
Fellowship in the open country outside the city; there will be no occasion for regret.

hexagrams.judgment_en: Possession in Great Measure brings great progress and success.
hexagrams.image_en: Fire above heaven is the image of great possession; the superior person represses evil and gives distinction to good, obeying the will of heaven.

lines.text_en: No approach to what is injurious and no error; let one be mindful of difficulty and there will be no error.
A large wagon with its load; there may be movement in any direction and no error.
A prince presents his offerings to the Son of Heaven; a small person could not do this.
One keeps his great resources under restraint; there will be no error.
Sincerity meets with sincerity and dignity is shown; there will be good fortune.
Help is given from heaven; good fortune and nothing but advantage.

hexagrams.judgment_en: Modesty brings progress and success; the superior person who is humble carries things through to the end.
hexagrams.image_en: A mountain in the midst of the earth is the image of modesty; the superior person diminishes what is excessive and increases what is deficient, weighing things and distributing fairly.

lines.text_en: The superior person adds modesty to modesty and crosses the great stream; good fortune.
Modesty that expresses itself; firm correctness brings good fortune.
The superior person of acknowledged merit who is modest carries things to completion; good fortune.
Everything is advantageous for one who stirs up modesty.
One need not be rich to employ neighbours; it is advantageous to use force to correct, and nothing will be unadvantageous.
Modesty that expresses itself; it is advantageous to set the army in motion to punish one’s own city and state.

hexagrams.judgment_en: Enthusiasm: it is advantageous to establish feudal princes and to set the army in motion.
hexagrams.image_en: Thunder issues from the earth with a crashing noise in the image of enthusiasm; the ancient kings made music to honour virtue and offered it to God and their ancestors.

lines.text_en: One proclaims his enthusiasm aloud; there will be misfortune.
Firm as a rock, one does not wait the whole day; firm correctness brings good fortune.
One looks up for enthusiasm and will have regret; delay also brings regret.
The source of enthusiasm attains great things; doubt not, for friends gather around like hair held by a clasp.
One is chronically ill with enthusiasm yet lives on and does not die.
Deluded enthusiasm, but if one changes course even after completion there will be no error.

hexagrams.judgment_en: Following brings great progress and success; it is advantageous to be firm and correct, and there will be no error.
hexagrams.image_en: Thunder within the marsh is the image of following; the superior person at nightfall goes within to rest and enjoy repose.

lines.text_en: One is changing the object of his pursuit; firm correctness brings good fortune, and going beyond the gate to meet others brings merit.
One clings to the little boy and lets go of the strong man.
One clings to the strong man and lets go of the little boy; by following he gets what he seeks, and firm correctness is advantageous.
Following and getting adherents will bring misfortune even in a correct course; sincerity in the right path brings clarity and no error.
Sincere in fostering what is excellent; there will be good fortune.
Sincerity firmly held and bound, as if the king were presenting offerings on the western mountain.

hexagrams.name_en_modern: Work on What Has Been Spoiled
hexagrams.judgment_en: Work on What Has Been Spoiled brings great progress and success; it is advantageous to cross the great stream, and one should consider three days before the starting point and three days after it.
hexagrams.image_en: Wind at the foot of the mountain is the image of decay; the superior person stirs up the people and nourishes their virtue.

lines.text_en: A son deals with the troubles caused by his father; if he is able, the father will escape blame, and though perilous the end will be fortunate.
A son deals with the troubles caused by his mother; he should not be too firm.
A son deals with the troubles caused by his father with some small regret, but no great error.
A son views indulgently the troubles caused by his father; going on he will find cause for regret.
A son deals with the troubles caused by his father and obtains praise.
One does not serve king or prince, but holds his own lofty aims.

hexagrams.judgment_en: Approach brings great progress and success, with firm correctness; in the eighth month there will be misfortune.
hexagrams.image_en: The earth above the marsh is the image of approach; the superior person is inexhaustible in teaching and boundless in protecting the people.

lines.text_en: Approach in common with others; firm correctness brings good fortune.
Approach in common; good fortune, and everything is advantageous.
Approach that is complacent and sweet brings no advantage; if one grieves over it, there will be no error.
Approach in the highest degree; no error.
Approach by means of wisdom, as befits a great ruler; good fortune.
Approach that is honest and generous; good fortune and no error.

hexagrams.judgment_en: Contemplation: the worshipper has washed his hands but has not yet presented his offerings, full of sincerity and dignified.
hexagrams.image_en: Wind moving above the earth is the image of contemplation; the ancient kings examined the regions, observed the people and set forth their instructions.

lines.text_en: Contemplation like that of a boy, no error for a small person, but regret for the superior person.
Contemplation through a crack of the door; advantageous for the firm correctness of a woman.
One contemplates his own life and decides whether to advance or retreat.
Contemplation of the glory of the kingdom; it is advantageous to be a guest of the king.
One contemplates his own life; the superior person will thus be free from error.
One contemplates his character to see if it is that of a superior person; he will be free from error.

hexagrams.judgment_en: Biting Through brings success; it is advantageous to use legal constraints.
hexagrams.image_en: Thunder and lightning together are the image of biting through; the ancient kings made the penalties clear and promulgated the laws.

lines.text_en: Feet in the stocks so that the toes are hidden; there will be no error.
One bites through soft flesh and goes on to the nose; there will be no error.
One bites dried meat and meets something poisonous; small regret but no error.
One bites dried gristly meat and finds a metal arrow; firmness amid difficulty brings good fortune.
One bites dried meat and finds yellow gold; perseverance in peril brings no error.
A cangue on the neck so that the ears are hidden; there will be misfortune.

hexagrams.judgment_en: Grace brings success, but it is advantageous to undertake only small matters.
hexagrams.image_en: Fire at the foot of the mountain is the image of grace; the superior person throws light on government affairs but does not dare to decide litigation by it.

lines.text_en: One adorns his feet, leaves the carriage and walks.
One adorns his beard.
Adorned and bedewed; perpetual firm correctness brings good fortune.
Adorned yet simple, white as a flying horse; the suitor is not a robber but seeks a union.
Grace in the hills and gardens with only a small roll of silk to offer; there is some regret, but in the end good fortune.
Simple grace in white; there will be no error.

hexagrams.judgment_en: Splitting Apart: it is not advantageous to make a movement in any direction.
hexagrams.image_en: The mountain rests on the earth in the image of splitting apart; those above make their position secure only by generosity to those below.

lines.text_en: One overturns the couch by splitting its legs; disregard of firmness brings misfortune.
One overturns the couch by splitting its frame; disregard of firmness brings misfortune.
One splits away from the others; there will be no error.
One overturns the couch and splits the skin of him upon it; misfortune.
A string of fishes, favour from the palace ladies; everything is advantageous.
A large fruit still uneaten: the superior person obtains a carriage, the small people split their own houses apart.

hexagrams.judgment_en: Return brings progress and success; going out and coming in without error, friends come without blame, and on the seventh day comes the return; it is advantageous to have somewhere to go.
hexagrams.image_en: Thunder within the earth is the image of return; the ancient kings closed the passes at the solstice, merchants did not travel and the ruler did not inspect the regions.

lines.text_en: Returning from a short distance without going astray; great good fortune.
An admirable return; good fortune.
Repeated returns with peril, but no error.
One walks in the midst of others yet returns alone.
A noble-hearted return; there will be no regret.
One has gone astray in returning, misfortune and calamity; an army set in motion will be defeated and the ruler suffers, and for ten years no attack is possible.

hexagrams.judgment_en: Innocence brings great progress and success with firm correctness; one who is not correct meets calamity and should not move in any direction.
hexagrams.image_en: Thunder rolls beneath heaven and all things are given their innocence; the ancient kings nourished all things in accordance with the seasons.

lines.text_en: Innocent movement brings good fortune.
One reaps without having ploughed and harvests in the third year without having tilled; it is advantageous to have somewhere to go.
Undeserved calamity: a cow tied up is gained by a passer-by and the villager is blamed.
One can remain firm and correct; there will be no error.
Undeserved illness: use no medicine and there will be rejoicing.
Innocent action now brings calamity; nothing is advantageous.

hexagrams.name_en_modern: The Taming Power of the Great
hexagrams.judgment_en: The Taming Power of the Great: firm correctness is advantageous, not to eat at home brings good fortune, and it is advantageous to cross the great stream.
hexagrams.image_en: Heaven within the mountain is the image of great accumulation; the superior person stores up the words and deeds of the ancients to nourish his virtue.

lines.text_en: Peril is at hand; it will be advantageous to desist.
The axle strap is removed from the carriage.
Good horses follow one another; it is advantageous to be firm amid difficulty and to practise chariot driving and defence daily, with somewhere to go.
The headboard of a young bull; great good fortune.
The tusks of a gelded boar; good fortune.
One commands the road of heaven; progress and success.

hexagrams.judgment_en: Nourishment with firm correctness brings good fortune; observe how a person nourishes others and what he seeks to fill his own mouth with.
hexagrams.image_en: Thunder at the foot of the mountain is the image of nourishment; the superior person is careful in his words and temperate in eating and drinking.

lines.text_en: You let your magic tortoise go and look at me with mouth drooping; misfortune.
One looks for nourishment from the top of the hill in a perverse way; going forward brings misfortune.
One acts contrary to the proper way of nourishment; firmness brings misfortune, and for ten years nothing is advantageous.
Seeking nourishment from above with a tiger’s downward glare and insatiable craving; good fortune and no error.
One acts contrary to the usual way; firm abiding brings good fortune, but do not cross the great stream.
The source of nourishment: peril but good fortune, and it is advantageous to cross the great stream.

hexagrams.judgment_en: Preponderance of the Great: the ridgepole sags to the breaking point; it is advantageous to have somewhere to go, and there will be success.
hexagrams.image_en: The marsh rises above the trees in the image of great excess; the superior person stands alone without fear and withdraws from the world without regret.

lines.text_en: One places white mats of rushes beneath things; there will be no error.
A withered willow puts forth shoots and an old man takes a young wife; everything is advantageous.
The ridgepole sags; there will be misfortune.
The ridgepole is braced; good fortune, but if there are ulterior motives there will be regret.
A withered willow puts forth flowers and an old woman takes a young husband; no blame but no praise.
One wades through the stream till the water covers his head; misfortune but no error.

hexagrams.judgment_en: The Abysmal repeated: through sincerity the mind penetrates, and action brings high value.
hexagrams.image_en: Water flows on continually and reaches its goal in the image of the repeated abyss; the superior person maintains constant virtue and continues to teach.

lines.text_en: In the repeated abyss one enters a cavern within the pit; misfortune.
In the abyss there is danger; one should seek only small success.
Coming to the abyss and finding it deep and dangerous, one should not act, for to go in only deeper brings no advantage.
A jug of wine and a bowl of rice, earthen vessels handed in through the window; in the end there will be no error.
The abyss is not filled to overflowing but only to the level; there will be no error.
Bound with cords and placed among thorns, one cannot find his way for three years; misfortune.

hexagrams.judgment_en: The Clinging: firm correctness is advantageous and brings success; to care for the cow brings good fortune.
hexagrams.image_en: Brightness doubled is the image of fire; the great person by perpetuating this brightness illumines the four quarters.

lines.text_en: Footsteps in confusion; if one is reverent there will be no error.
Yellow light; great good fortune.
In the light of the setting sun, if one does not beat the earthen pot and sing, he laments the approach of old age; misfortune.
It comes abruptly, blazes up, dies and is thrown away.
Tears in floods and lamenting; good fortune.
The king uses him to go forth and punish, and he crushes the leaders but not their followers; there will be no error.

hexagrams.judgment_en: Influence brings success through firm correctness; to take a maiden in marriage brings good fortune.
hexagrams.image_en: A lake on the mountain is the image of influence; the superior person keeps his mind free and open to receive others.

lines.text_en: Influence shown in the big toes.
Influence shown in the calves of the legs; misfortune, but to remain still brings good fortune.
Influence in the thighs: one follows what the heart desires, and to go on so brings regret.
Firm correctness brings good fortune and regret disappears; but if the mind wavers in agitation, only friends follow one’s thoughts.
Influence shown in the back of the neck; there will be no regret.
Influence shown in the jaws, cheeks and tongue.

hexagrams.judgment_en: Duration brings success and no error; firm correctness is advantageous, and it is advantageous to have somewhere to go.
hexagrams.image_en: Thunder and wind are the image of duration; the superior person stands firm and does not change his course.

lines.text_en: One seeks duration too deeply at the start; firmness brings misfortune, and nothing is advantageous.
All occasion for regret disappears.
One does not make his virtue lasting and may be disgraced; firmness brings regret.
A field with no game in it.
One makes his virtue lasting: firmness brings good fortune for a wife, misfortune for a husband.
Duration in agitation; there will be misfortune.

hexagrams.judgment_en: Retreat brings success; in what is small, firm correctness is advantageous.
hexagrams.image_en: The mountain beneath heaven is the image of retreat; the superior person keeps small people at a distance, not with anger but with dignity.

lines.text_en: At the tail of the retreat there is peril; one should not try to go anywhere.
One holds fast with the hide of a yellow ox; nothing can tear it loose.
A halting retreat, with distress and peril; to keep servants and concubines brings good fortune.
A voluntary retreat brings good fortune to the superior person and downfall to the small person.
An admirable retreat; firm correctness brings good fortune.
A noble retreat; everything is advantageous.

hexagrams.judgment_en: The Power of the Great: firm correctness is advantageous.
hexagrams.image_en: Thunder above heaven is the image of great power; the superior person does not tread a path that is not according to propriety.

lines.text_en: Power in the toes; advancing brings misfortune, however certain one feels.
Firm correctness brings good fortune.
The small person uses his strength and the superior person does not; firmness is perilous, like a ram butting a hedge and entangling its horns.
Firm correctness brings good fortune and regret disappears; the hedge opens without entanglement, and the strength is like the axle of a great wagon.
One loses the ram too easily; there will be no regret.
The ram butts the hedge and can neither retreat nor advance; nothing is advantageous, but if one notes the difficulty there is good fortune.

hexagrams.judgment_en: Progress: the powerful prince is honoured with many horses and received three times in a single day.
hexagrams.image_en: The sun rises above the earth in the image of progress; the superior person gives himself to making his bright virtue brighter.

lines.text_en: Progressing yet turned back; firm correctness brings good fortune, and if confidence is lacking, remain calm and there will be no error.
Progressing in sorrow; firm correctness brings good fortune, and one receives great blessing from the ancestress.
All around trust him; regret disappears.
Progressing like a hamster; firmness brings peril.
Regret disappears; take not to heart loss or gain, for advancing brings good fortune and everything is advantageous.
Progressing with the horns, only to punish one’s own city; peril but good fortune and no error, though firmness brings regret.

hexagrams.judgment_en: Darkening of the Light: it is advantageous to be firm and correct amid difficulty.
hexagrams.image_en: The light has sunk into the earth; the superior person in dealing with the multitude veils his brightness yet still shines.

lines.text_en: The light is darkened in flight and lowers its wings; the superior person travels three days without eating, and his host murmurs against him.
The light is darkened and he is wounded in the left thigh; he saves himself with a strong horse, good fortune.
Hunting in the south, the light is darkened and the great chief is captured; one should not be hasty in setting things right.
He enters the left side of the belly and gets at the heart of the darkening, then leaves the gate and courtyard.
The darkening of the light as with Prince Ji; firm correctness is advantageous.
Not light but darkness; first he climbed to heaven, then he plunged into the earth.

hexagrams.judgment_en: The Family: the firm correctness of the wife is advantageous.
hexagrams.image_en: Wind coming forth from fire is the image of the family; the superior person has substance in his words and duration in his conduct.

lines.text_en: Firm rules are established within the household; regret disappears.
The wife should not follow her own whims but attend to the food within; firm correctness brings good fortune.
When the household is treated with severity there is regret, yet good fortune; when wife and children giggle and laugh, in the end there is regret.
The wife enriches the household; great good fortune.
The king approaches his family; have no anxiety, for there will be good fortune.
Sincerity and awe-inspiring dignity; in the end there will be good fortune.

hexagrams.judgment_en: Opposition: in small matters there will be good fortune.
hexagrams.image_en: Fire above and the lake below are the image of opposition; the superior person retains his individuality amid all fellowship.

lines.text_en: Regret disappears; if one loses his horses do not chase them, they will return, and even an evil man seen brings no error.
One meets his lord in a narrow lane; there will be no error.
One sees his wagon dragged back, his oxen halted, his hair and nose cut off; no good beginning but a good end.
Isolated by opposition, one meets a like-minded man and both are sincere; peril but no error.
Regret disappears; the companion bites through the skin, and going forward there will be no error.

Isolated by opposition one sees a pig covered with mud and a wagonload of ghosts, draws the bow then lays it aside; it is not a robber but a suitor, and going forth when rain falls brings good fortune.

hexagrams.judgment_en: Obstruction: the south-west is advantageous, the north-east is not; it is advantageous to see the great person, and firm correctness brings good fortune.
hexagrams.image_en: Water on the mountain is the image of obstruction; the superior person turns to himself and cultivates his virtue.

lines.text_en: Going leads to obstruction, coming back to praise.
The king’s servant meets obstruction upon obstruction, but not through his own fault.
Going leads to obstruction, hence he returns.
Going leads to obstruction, coming back to union with others.
In the greatest obstruction, friends come.
Going leads to obstruction, coming back to great good fortune; it is advantageous to see the great person.

hexagrams.judgment_en: Deliverance: the south-west is advantageous; if there is nowhere further to go, returning brings good fortune, and if there is somewhere to go, hastening brings good fortune.
hexagrams.image_en: Thunder and rain set in and the image of deliverance; the superior person pardons mistakes and deals gently with wrongdoing.

lines.text_en: There will be no error.
One catches three foxes in the field and gets a yellow arrow; firm correctness brings good fortune.
A porter riding in a carriage invites robbers; firmness brings regret.
Deliver yourself from your great toe; then the friend comes and you can trust him.
If only the superior person can deliver himself it brings good fortune, and he proves to the small people that he is in earnest.
The prince shoots at a hawk on the high wall and kills it; everything is advantageous.

hexagrams.judgment_en: Decrease combined with sincerity brings great good fortune without error; firm correctness is possible and advantageous, and even two small bowls may be used for the offering.
hexagrams.image_en: The lake at the foot of the mountain is the image of decrease; the superior person restrains his anger and represses his desires.

lines.text_en: Going quickly when one’s own tasks are done brings no error, but one should consider how much to decrease others.
Firm correctness is advantageous, undertaking anything brings misfortune; one can increase others without decreasing oneself.
When three walk together one is lost; when one walks alone he finds a companion.
One diminishes his ailment and makes the other hasten to come with joy; no error.
One is increased by ten pairs of tortoise shells that cannot be refused; great good fortune.
One is increased without depriving others, no error, firm correctness brings good fortune; it is advantageous to go somewhere, and one gains servants but no longer has a separate home.

hexagrams.judgment_en: Increase: it is advantageous to have somewhere to go and to cross the great stream.
hexagrams.image_en: Wind and thunder are the image of increase; the superior person when he sees good imitates it and when he has faults corrects them.

lines.text_en: It is advantageous to accomplish great deeds; great good fortune and no error.
One is increased by ten pairs of tortoise shells that cannot be refused; perpetual firmness brings good fortune, and the king presents offerings to God.
One is enriched through unfortunate events; no blame if one is sincere, walks the middle path and reports to the prince with a seal.
If one walks in the middle and reports to the prince, he will follow; it is advantageous to be used in moving the capital.
With a sincere heart one seeks to benefit all, no question about it, supreme good fortune; sincerity is recognised as one’s virtue.
One brings increase to no one and someone even strikes him; he does not keep his heart constant, misfortune.

hexagrams.judgment_en: Breakthrough: one must resolutely make the matter known at the king’s court and announce it sincerely though there is peril; he should inform his own city and not resort to arms, but it is advantageous to have somewhere to go.
hexagrams.image_en: The lake has risen up to heaven in the image of breakthrough; the superior person dispenses riches downward and refrains from resting on his virtue.

lines.text_en: Mighty in the advancing toes; going forward without ability to succeed brings blame.
A cry of alarm and arms at evening and night; fear not.
Power in the cheekbones brings misfortune; the superior person is firmly resolved, walks alone in rain and is bespattered, murmured against but without error.
No skin on the thighs and walking with difficulty; if one let himself be led like a sheep regret would vanish, but he hears the words and does not believe.
Dealing with weeds requires firm resolution; walking in the middle there is no error.
No cry; in the end there will be misfortune.

hexagrams.judgment_en: Coming to Meet: the woman is bold and strong; one should not marry such a woman.
hexagrams.image_en: Wind beneath heaven is the image of coming to meet; the ruler issues his commands and proclaims them to the four quarters.

lines.text_en: It must be checked with a brake of bronze; firm correctness brings good fortune, and if one lets things take their course misfortune follows, like a lean pig straining to run about.
There is a fish in the tank; no error, but it is not advantageous to let it reach the guests.
No skin on the thighs and walking with difficulty; peril but no great error.
No fish in the tank; this gives rise to misfortune.
A melon covered with willow leaves hides its brightness; it falls from heaven.
One comes to meet with his horns; regret but no error.

hexagrams.judgment_en: Gathering Together brings success; the king approaches his ancestral temple, it is advantageous to see the great person, firm correctness brings success, and great offerings bring good fortune, with somewhere to go.
hexagrams.image_en: The lake above the earth is the image of gathering; the superior person renews his weapons to meet the unforeseen.

lines.text_en: Sincerity not carried to the end brings now confusion, now gathering; if one cries out, a single grasp of the hand brings laughter, and going on there is no error.
Letting oneself be drawn brings good fortune and no error; if one is sincere, even a small offering is advantageous.
Gathering amid sighs, nothing advantageous; going on brings no error but small regret.
Great good fortune and no error.
In gathering one holds his position, no error, but some are not yet sincere; sublime and enduring firmness makes regret disappear.
Lamenting and sighing, floods of tears; there will be no error.

hexagrams.judgment_en: Pushing Upward brings great progress and success; one must see the great person without anxiety, and advancing to the south brings good fortune.
hexagrams.image_en: Wood grows within the earth in the image of pushing upward; the superior person in devotion to virtue heaps up small things to achieve something high and great.

lines.text_en: Pushing upward that is welcomed; great good fortune.
If one is sincere, even a small offering is advantageous; there will be no error.
One pushes upward into an empty city.
The king offers sacrifice on Mount Qi; good fortune and no error.
Firm correctness brings good fortune; one pushes upward by steps.
Pushing upward in darkness; it is advantageous to be unremittingly firm and correct.

hexagrams.judgment_en: Oppression may yet lead to success; firm correctness brings good fortune to the great person without error, but when one has something to say it is not believed.
hexagrams.image_en: The lake with no water in it is the image of exhaustion; the superior person stakes his life on following his will.

lines.text_en: One sits oppressed under a bare tree and enters a dark valley, and for three years sees nothing.
Oppressed amid wine and food, the man in the scarlet knee-covers is just coming; it is advantageous to offer sacrifice, but advancing brings misfortune, though no error.
Oppressed by stones, one leans on thorns and thistles, enters his house and does not see his wife; misfortune.
One comes very slowly, oppressed in a bronze carriage; regret, but a good end.
Nose and feet cut off, oppressed by the man in the scarlet knee-covers; joy comes softly, and it is advantageous to make offerings.
Oppressed by creeping vines on a precarious height, one says that every move brings regret; if he repents and moves there is good fortune.

hexagrams.judgment_en: The Well: the town may be changed but the well cannot; it neither decreases nor increases, people come and go and draw from it, but if the rope is too short or the jug breaks there is misfortune.
hexagrams.image_en: Water above wood is the image of the well; the superior person encourages the people at their work and exhorts them to help one another.

lines.text_en: The mud of the well is not drunk; no animals come to an old well.
At the well-hole one shoots fish; the jug is broken and leaks.
The well is cleaned but no one drinks from it, to the sorrow of my heart; it could be used, and if the king were clear-minded all would share the blessing.
The well is being lined; there will be no error.
In the well there is a clear cold spring from which one may drink.
One draws from the well without hindrance, and it is dependable; sincerity brings supreme good fortune.

hexagrams.judgment_en: Revolution: only when the day of change has come is one believed; great progress and success through firm correctness, and regret disappears.
hexagrams.image_en: Fire in the lake is the image of revolution; the superior person sets the calendar in order and makes the seasons clear.

lines.text_en: One is bound with the hide of a yellow ox.
When one’s own day comes one may bring about revolution; advancing brings good fortune and no error.
Advancing brings misfortune, firmness brings peril; only when talk of revolution has gone round three times may one commit himself and be believed.
Regret disappears; one is believed and changes the form of government, good fortune.
The great person changes like a tiger; even before divining he is believed.
The superior person changes like a panther and the small people change their faces; advancing brings misfortune, firm abiding good fortune.

hexagrams.judgment_en: The Cauldron: great good fortune and success.
hexagrams.image_en: Fire above wood is the image of the cauldron; the superior person consolidates his fate by keeping his position correct.

lines.text_en: A cauldron turned upside down to remove what is stagnant; one takes a concubine for the sake of her son, no error.
There is food in the cauldron; my comrades are envious but cannot harm me, good fortune.
The handle of the cauldron is altered and one is impeded, the fat of the pheasant is not eaten; once the rain falls regret disappears and good fortune comes at last.
The legs of the cauldron are broken and the prince’s meal is spilled, and his person is soiled; misfortune.
The cauldron has yellow handles and golden carrying rings; firm correctness is advantageous.
The cauldron has rings of jade; great good fortune, nothing that is not advantageous.

hexagrams.judgment_en: The Arousing brings success; when thunder comes there is fear, then laughter and cheerful talk, and the shock terrifies for a hundred miles while one does not let fall the sacrificial spoon and chalice.
hexagrams.image_en: Thunder repeated is the image of the arousing; the superior person in fear and trembling sets his life in order and examines himself.

lines.text_en: Thunder comes with fear, then laughter and talk; good fortune.
Thunder comes with peril and one loses his treasures and climbs the nine hills; do not pursue them, for in seven days they return.
Thunder makes one distraught; if one is roused to action there will be no calamity.
The shock is mired in mud.
Thunder goes hither and thither with peril, but nothing is lost, and there is work to be done.

Thunder brings ruin and terrified gazing around, and advancing brings misfortune; if it has not yet touched one’s own body but only the neighbour, there is no error, though there will be talk among comrades.

hexagrams.judgment_en: Keeping Still: one keeps his back still and loses sense of his body, walks in the courtyard and does not see the people there; there will be no error.
hexagrams.image_en: Mountains standing close together are the image of keeping still; the superior person does not let his thoughts go beyond his position.

lines.text_en: Keeping the toes still; no error, and perpetual firm correctness is advantageous.
Keeping the calves still cannot rescue the one he follows; his heart is not glad.
Keeping the loins still and making the ribs stiff is perilous; the heart suffocates.
Keeping the trunk still; there will be no error.
Keeping the jaws still so that words have order; regret disappears.
Noble-hearted keeping still; good fortune.

hexagrams.judgment_en: Gradual Progress: the maiden is given in marriage, good fortune, and firm correctness is advantageous.
hexagrams.image_en: A tree on the mountain is the image of gradual development; the superior person abides in dignity and virtue to improve the manners of the people.

lines.text_en: The wild goose gradually approaches the shore; the young son is in danger and there is talk, but no error.
The wild goose gradually approaches the cliff and eats and drinks in peace and concord; good fortune.
The wild goose gradually approaches the dry plateau; the husband goes forth and does not return, the wife is pregnant but does not bear, misfortune, though it is advantageous to resist robbers.
The wild goose gradually approaches the tree and may find a flat branch; no error.
The wild goose gradually approaches the summit; for three years the wife does not conceive, but in the end nothing can hinder her, good fortune.
The wild goose gradually approaches the cloud heights; its feathers can be used for the sacred dance, good fortune.

hexagrams.judgment_en: The Marrying Maiden: undertakings bring misfortune, and nothing is advantageous.
hexagrams.image_en: Thunder over the lake is the image of the marrying maiden; the superior person understands the transitory in the light of eternity.

lines.text_en: The maiden is married as a secondary wife; a lame man who can still tread, advancing brings good fortune.
A one-eyed man who can still see; the firm correctness of a solitary woman is advantageous.
The maiden was to marry in a lowly position and returns as a secondary wife.
The maiden delays her marriage beyond the proper time, but a late marriage comes in due course.
The emperor Yi gave his younger sister in marriage, and her embroidered garments were less fine than those of the secondary wife; the moon almost full brings good fortune.
The woman holds a basket with nothing in it and the man stabs a sheep without blood flowing; nothing is advantageous.

hexagrams.judgment_en: Abundance brings progress and success; the king attains it, be not sad, and be like the sun at midday.
hexagrams.image_en: Thunder and lightning come together in the image of abundance; the superior person decides lawsuits and carries out punishments.

lines.text_en: One meets his destined lord and may be with him ten days without error; going forward brings recognition.
The curtain is so dense that the Pole star is seen at midday; going forward meets with suspicion and hatred, but sincerity moves others and brings good fortune.
The curtain is so dense that small stars are seen at noon; one breaks his right arm, but there is no error.
The curtain is so dense that the Pole star is seen at midday; one meets his lord who is of like kind, good fortune.
Lines are coming, bringing blessing and fame; good fortune.
One has his house in a state of abundance yet screens off his family, peers through the gate and sees no one for three years; misfortune.

hexagrams.judgment_en: The Wanderer: success in small things; firm correctness brings good fortune to the wanderer.
hexagrams.image_en: Fire on the mountain is the image of the wanderer; the superior person is clear and cautious in imposing penalties and does not protract lawsuits.

lines.text_en: The wanderer busies himself with trivial things and draws down calamity upon himself.
The wanderer comes to an inn with his property and wins the steadfastness of a young servant.
The wanderer burns his inn and loses the steadfastness of his young servant; firmness brings peril.
The wanderer rests in a shelter and obtains his property and an axe, but his heart is not glad.
One shoots a pheasant and loses an arrow, but in the end obtains praise and office.
The bird burns its nest; the wanderer laughs at first, then laments and weeps, and loses his cow through carelessness, misfortune.

hexagrams.judgment_en: The Gentle brings success in small things; it is advantageous to have somewhere to go and to see the great person.
hexagrams.image_en: Winds following one another are the image of the gentle; the superior person spreads his commands abroad and carries out his undertakings.

lines.text_en: Advancing and retreating; the firm correctness of a warrior is advantageous.
Penetration under the bed; priests and magicians are used in great number, good fortune and no error.
Repeated and importunate penetration brings regret.
Regret disappears; one takes three kinds of game in the hunt.
Firm correctness brings good fortune, regret disappears and nothing is unadvantageous; no beginning but a good end, with three days before the change and three days after, good fortune.
Penetration under the bed; one loses his property and his axe, and firmness brings misfortune.

hexagrams.judgment_en: The Joyous brings progress and success; firm correctness is advantageous.
hexagrams.image_en: Lakes resting one on the other are the image of the joyous; the superior person joins with friends for discussion and practice.

lines.text_en: Harmonious joy; good fortune.
Sincere joy; good fortune, and regret disappears.
Joy that comes from without; misfortune.
Joy that is weighed and not at rest; if one removes what is injurious there will be rejoicing.
Sincerity toward what is disintegrating; there is peril.
Seductive joy that leads one on.

hexagrams.judgment_en: Dispersion brings success; the king approaches his ancestral temple, it is advantageous to cross the great stream, and firm correctness is advantageous.
hexagrams.image_en: Wind blows over the water in the image of dispersion; the ancient kings sacrificed to God and built temples.

lines.text_en: One brings help with the strength of a horse; good fortune.
At the dispersion one hurries to his support; regret disappears.
One disperses his own self; there will be no regret.
One disperses his bond with his group, supreme good fortune; dispersion leads to accumulation, which ordinary people do not think of.
One disperses his sweat with loud cries and the king’s stores are scattered; there will be no error.
One disperses his blood, keeps at a distance and departs; there will be no error.

hexagrams.judgment_en: Limitation brings progress and success, but galling limitation must not be persevered in.
hexagrams.image_en: Water over the lake is the image of limitation; the superior person creates number and measure and examines the nature of virtue and conduct.

lines.text_en: One does not go out of the door and courtyard; there will be no error.
One does not go out of the gate and courtyard; misfortune.
One who knows no limitation will have cause to lament; there will be no error.
Contented limitation; progress and success.
Sweet limitation brings good fortune; going forward brings esteem.
Galling limitation; firmness brings misfortune, but regret disappears.

hexagrams.judgment_en: Inner Truth moves even pigs and fishes, bringing good fortune; it is advantageous to cross the great stream, and firm correctness is advantageous.
hexagrams.image_en: Wind over the lake is the image of inner truth; the superior person deliberates on criminal cases and delays executions.

lines.text_en: Being prepared brings good fortune; if there are secret designs, there is disquiet.
A crane calls in the shade and its young answer it; I have a goblet of good wine and will share it with you.
One finds a comrade, now beats the drum, now stops, now weeps, now sings.
The moon is nearly full and the team horse goes astray; there will be no error.
One possesses truth that binds others together; there will be no error.
A cock-crow trying to rise to heaven; firmness brings misfortune.

hexagrams.judgment_en: Preponderance of the Small brings success with firm correctness; small things may be done but not great, and the flying bird leaves a message that one should not strive upward but remain below, great good fortune.
hexagrams.image_en: Thunder on the mountain is the image of small excess; the superior person in conduct exceeds in reverence, in mourning in grief, and in expenditure in thrift.

lines.text_en: A bird that flies upward meets misfortune.
One passes by his ancestor and meets his ancestress, does not reach his prince but meets the minister; no error.
If one is not extremely careful somebody may come up from behind and strike him; misfortune.
No error; one meets the other without passing by, and going on brings peril, so one must be on guard and not act, since perpetual firmness is not advantageous.
Dense clouds but no rain from our western borders; the prince shoots and hits the one in the cave.
One passes by without meeting; the flying bird leaves him, misfortune, and this means calamity and injury.

hexagrams.judgment_en: After Completion brings success in small matters; firm correctness is advantageous, good fortune at the beginning but disorder at the end.
hexagrams.image_en: Water over fire is the image of the condition after completion; the superior person takes thought of misfortune and arms himself against it in advance.

lines.text_en: One drags back his wheels and wets his tail; there will be no error.
The woman loses the curtain of her carriage; do not run after it, for in seven days she will get it.
The Illustrious Ancestor attacks the Devil’s Country and subdues it after three years; small people should not be employed.
The finest clothes turn to rags; one must be careful all day long.
The neighbour in the east slaughters an ox, but the neighbour in the west with his small offering receives more of the blessing.
One gets his head wet; there is peril.

hexagrams.judgment_en: Before Completion brings success, but if the little fox, having nearly crossed the stream, gets its tail wet, nothing is advantageous.
hexagrams.image_en: Fire above water is the image of the condition before completion; the superior person carefully discriminates among things so that each finds its place.

lines.text_en: One gets his tail wet; there will be occasion for regret.
One drags back his wheels; firm correctness brings good fortune.
Before completion, attack brings misfortune, yet it is advantageous to cross the great stream.
Firm correctness brings good fortune and regret disappears; with a shock one attacks the Devil’s Country and after three years is rewarded with a great kingdom.
Firm correctness brings good fortune and no regret; the light of the superior person is sincere, good fortune.
There is sincerity in drinking wine, no error; but if one wets his head there is loss of sincerity.
